integrity: Algebraic proof and reproducible standalone finite-field checker included; finite checks corroborate but do not prove unrestricted results. No external certification or independent mathematical validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Odd characteristic, three generators, regular representation; complete homogeneous quadratic census and only nonsingular higher-order lifts. Degenerate higher-order lifts, characteristic two and nonregular modules are not addressed. Historical priority remains subject to independent literature review.
title: Morse-rigid Jordan spectra of ternary quadratic layers in modular group algebras
